By design, not a regression: a tree closed at linger expiry keeps every claim's session_file while its cleanup releases the volumes, so re-admitting one of its issues takes the lost-volume relaunch (workspace-init exit 3, `volume was lost` once, a fresh session with workspace-recovered.json) — stage 4b's re-admission checkpoint asserts exactly that; the done child's own close drops the sessions first, so it re-enters fresh without the detour.

This tester pod still runs the tree-volume layout of the deployed daemon: nproc 8 and MemTotal 62 GiB with no reservation, five issue workspaces of LEGION-578 on one volume — the shape this change replaces.
